name: Force XPLR eTap AXS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed reference for the twelve-speed, 1x, 44T-max Force XPLR eTap AXS D1 rear derailleur, without battery. SRAM’s XPLR support FAQ explicitly excludes batteries. This is the conventional-hanger version, separate from thirteen-speed Full Mount models.
